title: Golakka Hot Springs
wikitext:
[[Image:Golakka_Hot_Springs.jpg|thumb|Golakka Hot Springs]]
'''Golakka Hot Springs''' is a region in western [[Un'goro Crater]], north of [[Terror Run]]. The area features geysers and pools heated by the nearby volcano. One lone [[goblin]] can also be found here - [[Krakle]] is investigating the connection between the hot springs and the nearby [[Fire Plume Ridge]]. An interesting note is that the tall white geyser behind Krakle is a lot deeper than it looks...
